title: OverShielded - one-thumb tactical deckbuilder
author: SquareTowel8600
selftext:
Hey! I’ve been working solo on my first ever mobile game called **OverShielded**, a mobile tactical deckbuilder built around a slightly unusual combat system (i hope so).

I am using vibecoding to reach my goal.

You control a party of four characters, but instead of playing a hand of cards, you deal with **one circular shield at a time**.

  
Each card in deck is represented as a shield, which is divided into four quarters, with different effects assigned to them. Swiping in a direction chooses which party member acts, while rotating the shield changes which effect is assigned to which character. Rotation costs a limited resource, so a lot of the combat is about deciding whether the current setup is good enough or worth spending resources to rearrange.  
There’s also deckbuilding, character development, equipment, formation management and different shield types that change how individual cards behave.

  
The game is heavily inspired by **Slay the Spire**, **Reigns** and **Darkest Dungeon** \- especially the deckbuilding and run structure of Slay the Spire, the simple directional interaction of Reigns, and the party/formation feeling of Darkest Dungeon.

There’s also deckbuilding, character development, equipment, formation management and different shield types that change how individual cards behave.

I’m still developing, but I wanted to finally start showing it to people.
